modules.name: Independent visual workspace
modules.summary: Project objects, real browser, runnable canvas, source editor, agent panel and execution timeline. Source view, browser expansion and 1100px layout pass.

modules.name: Real browser and observations
modules.summary: The visible Chromium page is the page the agent reads and operates. External HTTPS, actual form input and stale-observation rejection pass. Main-document controls are the current automation scope.

modules.name: Versioned artifact components
modules.summary: FactoryWorld entities, transactions and checkpoints back actual runnable files. Old versions and interrupted writes are preserved. Stale edits cannot overwrite current files.

modules.name: Native local-model tool loop
modules.summary: Local gpt-oss:20b completes the browser-to-counter-to-test-to-recipe fixture in four planning steps. Native tool calls are validated independently of answer and reasoning text. Other model quality is not assumed.

modules.name: Test receipts and reusable recipes
modules.summary: Only a current passing artifact becomes a recipe. Restart restores its files, test evidence and skill library. Reuse creates a new artifact and reruns the tests.

modules.name: Preserved Game Lab
modules.summary: The full inherited Java game editor renders in a separate native window with successor-only project storage. The original Studio application and repository remain separate.

modules.name: Broader artifacts and evaluated learning
modules.summary: Preserve the current UI; add replayable episodes, independently evaluated improvements, broader adapters, isolated workers and aligned vision/game observations through measured gates.

modules.name: Fraymus OS One learning assessment
modules.summary: Requested next review of existing learning code, update mechanisms, data formats and checkpoints. No training system is imported by this documentation release.
